name: miportafolio-monorepo
description: SDET portfolio and CV of Andrés Rodríguez Pisa: React web, Python CV backend and maestro MCP agent
author: Andrés Rodríguez Pisa

scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project apps/api --extra api python apps/api/run.py
scripts.test:backend: uv run --project apps/api --extra dev --extra api python -m pytest apps/api/tests -q
scripts.test:agent: uv run --project agent python -m pytest agent/tests -q
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test && pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:agent
scripts.cv:status: uv run --project apps/api python -m app status
scripts.cv:apply: uv run --project apps/api python -m app apply
scripts.cv:generate: uv run --project apps/api python -m app generate
scripts.release: pnpm run lint:all && pnpm run test:all && pnpm run sync:verify && pnpm run build
